summary: Frontend regression test of AdminPage.js refactoring (extracted UserEditModal, PasswordResetModal, SchaustellerEditModal, AdminManualExpiryDialog). All critical modal flows tested through real UI as admin@test.com — modals open correctly with all expected data-testid elements, props are properly threaded from parent state. No UI regressions found.

design_issues.screen: All Admin Modals (UserEditModal, PasswordResetModal, SchaustellerEditModal, AdminManualExpiryDialog)
issues: Console warning (a11y): 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — minor accessibility warning from Radix Dialog. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to each DialogContent. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js still 1298 lines — large but acceptable for a Parent orchestrator. Further extraction candidates: the expanded user-activity row (lines 1057-1165, ~110 lines) could become <UserActivityRow />, and the role/search sub-toolbar (lines 786-864) could become <UserFiltersBar />.
Accessibility: All four extracted DialogContent components miss DialogDescription / aria-describedby — Radix logs a warning. Quick win.

UserEditModal.jsx is 716 lines — flagged in problem statement as a refactor target. Internal sections (Filesharing block, Generator Monitoring block, Energy Monitoring block, Freelancer Assignment block) could each become their own sub-component to drop file size below 400 lines.

Module toggle key 'data-testid=\"module-toggle-adr\"' appears twice in UserEditModal.jsx (lines 183 and 695). Duplicate testid — Playwright/QueryAll will return two elements. Should rename one (e.g. 'module-toggle-adr-customer').

freelancer order search useEffect (AdminPage.js line 309-325) re-fires the API on every freelancerSearchQ keystroke even when modal is closed because dependency includes modalOpen — fine, but a leading guard could skip redundant initial fetch.
action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to all four extracted modal components to silence Radix a11y warning.
